description: This file defines an interface for a stateless worker stream producer grain in Orleans, a framework for building distributed applications. The interface includes a method to produce a message on a given stream.

classes.name: IStatelessWorkerStreamProducerGrain
classes.description: Interface for a stateless worker stream producer grain in Orleans, with a method to produce messages to a stream.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Asynchronously produces a message to a specified stream identified by streamId, using a specified provider.
